title: Act: Subscribe BootScene to highlightObject and release it on shutdown
summary: BootScene focuses the matching SceneObject on highlightObject and blurs others
description: Subscribe to reactToPhaser highlightObject in BootScene.create, apply focus or blur through SceneObject, and unsubscribe in the SHUTDOWN handler.
acceptance_criteria: highlightObject id focuses that object and blurs the rest
null blurs all; handler removed on shutdown

steps.action: Import reactToPhaser alongside phaserToReact from ./events and add a private field unsubscribeHighlight of type (() => void) | null initialised to null.
steps.code:
import { phaserToReact, reactToPhaser } from './events';
private unsubscribeHighlight: (() => void) | null = null;
steps.expected: File compiles with the new import and field

steps.action: Subscribe to highlightObject: for each scene object call focus() when spec.id equals the payload id, otherwise blur(); store the returned unsubscribe in unsubscribeHighlight.
steps.code: this.unsubscribeHighlight = reactToPhaser.on('highlightObject', ({ id }) => this.sceneObjects.forEach((o) => (o.spec.id === id ? o.focus() : o.blur())));
steps.expected: Emitting highlightObject focuses the matching object and null blurs all

steps.action: Inside the SHUTDOWN callback call this.unsubscribeHighlight?.() and set it to null next to the existing unsubscribe release.
steps.expected: After shutdown highlightObject no longer reaches scene objects
